newsitem.title: POLAND: LG Group ups stake in Petrobank.
newsitem.headline: LG Group ups stake in Petrobank.

text.p: South Korea's LG Investment Holdings B.V., a subsidiary of LG Group increased its stake in Polish Petrobank SA to 54.49 percent, from 50.09 percent, Petrobank said in a statement on Tuesday.
Petrobank said LG currently had 12,128,251 shares.
It did not give any other details.
The shares were bought at 12 zlotys per share.
LG bought the four percent of shares in Petrobank after it announced a public tender offer, required by law, to buy remaining shares from all other shareholders willing to sell their stock.
Under the Polish securities law any investor who acquires more than 33 percent of shares is obliged to invite other shareholders to sell their shares.
